prompt:
Run the program under gdb and let it crash; keep the session stopped at the crash. Then submit with an 'answer' JSON object with EXACTLY these fields, read from the live stopped state:
  "signal"          — the stop signal name (e.g. SIGSEGV)
  "fault_addr"      — the faulting memory address (any int format)
  "pc_function"     — the function containing the faulting PC (backtrace frame 0)
  "caller_function" — its caller (backtrace frame 1)

target.name: inspect_0003
